anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: Pressure difference rose to 5.728 mbar from 1.913 mbar at 1080 s, well above the earlier approximately 2 mbar baseline.
PDI702 remains elevated at 3.244 mbar while PDI701 falls to 0.029 mbar, indicating an unresolved pressure-drop disturbance.
Reflux and distillate flows fell to 0.565 and 0.010 L/h while system pressure dipped to 395.962 mbar.
Flows partially recovered to 0.668 and 0.030 L/h and system pressure returned to 398.807 mbar; this does not establish recovery of column hydraulics.

args.missing_evidence: Operating setpoints and commanded transitions, independent pressure-drop and flow checks, and subsequent readings are needed to distinguish a hydraulic disturbance from measurement error and determine the cause. Column temperature instruments are not installed; a composition measurement and separation target are needed to evaluate separation.
